degradation.measuredOnHost: pilot Work ECS (36.151.147.217), read-only systemd/proc/filesystem probe
degradation.measurement: runc, runsc, containerd, dockerd, podman and bubblewrap are all absent on the host; the deployed runtime copy mentions none of them (0 files matching runc|runsc|seccomp|cgroup|unshare|bwrap) and spawns the agent as a plain node child of the same interpreter (src/work/node/src/supervisor.mjs:249); the unit runs with PrivateUsers=no, RestrictNamespaces=no and an untrimmed CapabilityBoundingSet
compensatingControls: child environment is an allowlist, so no database, Temporal, provider or master-key variable reaches the child (src/work/node/src/supervisor.mjs:22,80-86), asserted by a sentinel test (src/work/node/test/supervisor-handshake.test.mjs:61,72)
the agent has no tool surface and no getApiKey (src/work/node/src/child-pi.mjs:373)
per-run nonce plus short-lived scoped capability over fd 4/5 instead of inherited credentials
degradation.residualRisk: a prompt-influenced child can send the content of its own run to any public address and can read whatever its scoped capability already fetched; there is no mount, syscall, pid or network namespace boundary around it, so a compromised interpreter is not contained
reopenConditions: real customer data enters the pilot
pooled concurrency beyond maxConcurrent is relied on for correctness
